Web · Wisconsin Creative

Board Sizes

Creative video staff need the exact pixel size of a venue board. The page now finds that board and copies the size, aspect ratio, and any safe area the sources already record.

Axe violations

0

axe-core 4.10.3 default rules, light and dark, on the venue, board, search, content, agents, issues, and tools pages.

Boards checked

223

Every display and zone id in manifest 2026-10-09.1. No size was added or changed.

Side by side

Before is the tools-branch snapshot at 55124f219bdfcd53bb54e270759eefd8c01d6733, because Board Sizes is not on main. After is this branch on top of main f59aee2a. Same Chrome headless settings, light appearance, manifest 2026-10-09.1, scroll at the top. The page does not render a clock.

What changed, and why

Copy the spec, not just the pixel count

Was

The size button copied 5760×1440. Aspect ratio, position, and safe area were somewhere else on the page.

Now

Copy spec writes the venue, board, size, aspect ratio, position, and only the safe area the manifest records. If none is recorded, the line says so.

Guides use the recorded pixels

Was

A downloaded guide was not one click away from the board.

Now

Guide SVG and Guide PNG are in More. The file is the board's exact width and height. A dashed inset is drawn only when a pad or title-safe inset is on file.

The manifest is the only size source

Was

data.js, the CSV, the index, and the design notes could drift from boards.json.

Now

node scripts/build-board-sizes.mjs regenerates them. --check fails when they drift, when a board grows an unknown field, or when a script hash on the page is stale.

Verification

  • node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/board-sizes.test.ts: 18 passed.
  • node scripts/build-board-sizes.mjs --check: fresh. validateSchema and validateManifest reported no problems. No dimension in boards.json was edited.
  • axe-core 4.10.3 default rules: 0 violations on Camp Randall, North Board, fascia search, Kohl Center, Goodman, open issues, a content type, the agent page, and /tools, at 1440×900 and 390×844 where listed. The same two board pages were clean in dark mode.
  • Keyboard: / focuses search, Escape closes More and the phone venue list, Copy spec wrote the North Board spec (5760x1440, 4:1, speaker scrims, 60.00 fps).
  • npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false: clean after prisma generate. ESLint on tests/board-sizes.test.ts and next.config.ts: clean. npm run build:app: completed. npm run codemap:check: clean after the test-count update. git diff --check: clean.
  • Lighthouse was not run. axe-core's target-size rule is disabled by default; on a phone, some zones in the scaled North Board drawing are under 24px. The zone rows underneath are the 40px copy controls.

Things to know

  • Twelve open questions stay in the manifest. Kohl Center frame rate disagrees (Colosseum 60 vs the After Effects project 59.94) on the centerhung, 16:9 feed, top ring, 360 fascia, tunnels, scorer's table, stanchion, and baseline table. The 16:9 feed is also unconfirmed. The Field House table names are not final, and zone 8 is still labeled Left GIP-BG. Goodman main is 560×308 from Colosseum only.
  • Nothing was invented to fill those gaps. Zones without a position still have no position. The house 59.94 note in the design guide is guidance, not a recorded frame rate.
  • This is not deployed. AC-10 in the showroom area doc stays unchecked until /board-sizes and /tools are proven on the deployed site.
  • Open pull request 471 also adds a copy of this tool, plus Golden Hour and Timelapse, and points /tools at a signed-in /apps page. This branch does not include those other tools.
